verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs say AI summaries are available right after each call and that it generates action items, which covers the 'right after each meeting' and 'next steps' parts. Custom summaries are also listed. Nothing documents a structure with key points and decisions, and nothing shows summaries are good enough to share unedited. Missing for 10: documented summary structure (key points, decisions sections), evidence that summaries are share-ready without editing, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote:
AI summaries instantly  
available after your call
Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries
Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
